title: Phantom Consensus: Measuring Social Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2611.08971v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly aggregate judgments across model instances, but reasoning about other agents can itself introduce failure. We study a setting in which LLMs shift their public decisions after observing ambiguous social signals while reporting inaccurate estimates of what other agents privately judged, even when the group's recorded private judgments do not support the apparent consensus. We call this failure phantom consensus and study it as a pluralistic-ignorance-style pattern in controlled LLM collectives. To measure this phenomenon, we introduce PHANTOM-Bench, a benchmark that separates isolated private judgments, public decisions after ambiguous social signals, elicited estimates of the group's private judgment, transparency-based recovery, and controls for neutral public text and explicit vote-following. Across nine closed- and open-weight models, ambiguous public signals consistently degrade decision quality

translated_title: 幻影共识：测量多智能体LLM决策中的社会推理
translated_abstract: 多智能体LLM系统日益在多个模型实例之间聚合判断，但对其他智能体进行推理本身可能引入失败。我们研究了一种情境：LLM在观察到模糊的社会信号后会改变其公开决策，同时却对其他智能体的私下判断作出不准确的估计，即使该群体记录在案的私下判断并不支持这种表面上的共识。我们将这种失败称为“幻影共识”，并将其作为一种多元无知式的模式在受控的LLM集体中进行研究。为了测量这一现象，我们引入了PHANTOM-Bench，这是一个基准测试，它将孤立的私下判断、模糊社会信号后的公开决策、诱导出的群体私下判断估计、基于透明度的恢复手段，以及中性公开文本和明确跟随投票的对照组区分开来。在九个闭源和开源权重模型中，模糊的公开信号持续地降低决策质量。
tldr: 该论文首次发现并命名了多智能体LLM系统中的“幻影共识”现象——智能体在模糊社会信号下改变公开决策却误判他人私下判断，并提出了PHANTOM-Bench基准来系统测量这种多元无知式失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies and names "phantom consensus" in multi-agent LLM systems—where agents shift public decisions under ambiguous social signals while misjudging others' private judgments—and introduces PHANTOM-Bench, a benchmark to systematically measure this pluralistic-ignorance-style failure across nine closed- and open-weight models.
